description: Connect your CompetitorFlow account to inspect your competitive portfolio from ChatGPT and Codex. List monitored competitors, review recent market movements, retrieve the evidence behind a Pulse, and search the competitive intelligence already stored in your account. Consult delivered reports and their opportunities, scorecards, and evidence. The plugin is read-only: it does not start crawls, generate new analyses, modify your portfolio, or send information to third parties.

defaultPrompt: Show me the competitors monitored in my CompetitorFlow account.
Summarize my most recent competitor Pulses and explain their business implications.
Search my competitive intelligence for recent pricing and positioning changes.
